name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
blurb: Applied Optoelectronics is a Texas-based maker of optical components and transceivers, historically known for serving cable-television networks and a handful of hyperscale customers in cycles of feast and famine. The AI build-out has dragged it firmly into the data-centre supply chain, where it now competes for 400G, 800G, and 1.6T transceiver volumes against Lumentum, Coherent, Innolight, and Eoptolink.
recent: Management is guiding to full-year 2026 revenue exceeding $1 billion, more than double 2025's roughly $456 million, on the back of 800G ramps and a single 1.6T order disclosed at over $200 million. The company aims to scale from roughly 90,000 800G units per month at end-2025 toward 500,000 800G/1.6T units per month by end-2026. The stock hit an all-time high near $192 in early May 2026, having traded as low as $12.56 within the last 52 weeks.
